what: Draws a rounded-square app icon with a single WebGL2 shader. Four harmonics (2·3·4·5) ripple softly through the outline on a 2.5s cycle, and the layered paper mark and gloss sway along that flow. When the cursor comes within the detection radius of the icon center, the closer it gets the more excited the icon becomes (inertia .3s): the ripple strengthens (.6→1), a cycle speeds up to 1.8s, and the icon swells to 1.2x. A spring of 1.6Hz · damping .7 pulls it toward the cursor (max .25), and when the cursor leaves it wobbles back into place. Pauses when off-screen.

options.excited-cycle: Time for one full turn when excited (s), default 1.8
options.pull: Drag strength, default .25 — 0 keeps it in place
options.unit: Inverse of the icon size relative to the panel contrast, default 1.6 (62% of the panel half-width)
options.--fx-jelly-a / -b / -ink: Top light color · bottom dark color · display color

note: The graphic was redrawn with our own shader (the original mixes a recorded icon sketchboard by mode). To change the mark (two overlapping sheets of paper), edit the two box entries in FRAG. Without WebGL2 it draws nothing and returns

from.where: index.html [data-slot=ai-connect] center of the tool icon row
